tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a public web page (http/https). Returns the image. Private/internal addresses are refused.

tools.name: render_pdf
tools.description: Render a public web page (url) or raw HTML (html) to PDF. Returns the PDF as an embedded resource.

tools.name: generate_og_image
tools.description: Generate a 1200x630 PNG social card (og:image) from a template and text.
